content: When NM API service with an invalid network handle is called, the called function shall not be executed, but instead of that it shall report UDPNM_E_INVALID_CH ANNEL to the Default Error Tracer (if development error detection is enabled) otherwise it shall return E_NOT_OK to the calling function
